title: Leo's Morning Routine Victory: Five Minutes Ahead of Time!

lines.text: BEEP BEEP! Seven o'clock alarm, and Leo was rushing around like a whirlwind!
lines.caps: *BEEP BEEP! Seven o'clock, | and Leo was rushing around like a *WHIRLWIND!

lines.text: Where is my left blue sneaker? Did anyone pack my homework notebook?
lines.caps: Where is my left *SNEAKER? | Did anyone pack my homework *NOTEBOOK?

lines.text: Spilling cereal, untied shoelaces, and running frantically as the yellow bus honked!
lines.caps: Spilling cereal, untied *LACES, | and running as the yellow bus *HONKED!

lines.text: That night, Rhymo said, Let's win tomorrow before we even close our eyes!
lines.caps: That night, Rhymo *SAID, | Let's win tomorrow before we close our *EYES!

lines.text: Step one: Backpack packed and zipped right by the front door!
lines.caps: *STEP ONE: | Backpack packed and zipped right by the *FRONT DOOR!

lines.text: Step two: Blue sneakers placed side-by-side with socks inside!
Next morning, Leo woke up, got dressed in three minutes, and ate pancakes calmly!
lines.caps: Next morning, Leo dressed in three *MINUTES | and ate pancakes *CALMLY!

lines.text: He strolled to the bus stop five minutes early, smiling like a champion!
lines.caps: He strolled to the bus stop *EARLY, | smiling like a true *CHAMPION!
